description: The pens every plan, elevation, section and sheet is drawn with (SVG, PDF and DXF): per kind of line work in layers (wall, cut, hatched, hatch, opening, below, overhead, slab, elev, dimension, note, room, grid, section) and per tag in tags (by name, e.g. Demolish dashed, Existing grey; a tag's pen wins). Each takes pen (width on paper, mm: 0.13, 0.18, 0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.7), line (solid, dashed, dotted, dashdot) and colour (#rrggbb); null clears one. room_label: what room labels in plans say, a template with fields in braces ({Name}, {Area}, {Gross area}, {Perimeter}, {Level} or a custom property of the room), one line each, the first bold; null for the usual name and area. reset starts again from the defaults.
name: set_drawing_styles
title: Set drawing pens and labels
